It is position_zero_dominated if more than 20 times its chance share (1/64) of its activations are at position 0. It is a position_zero_artefact if at least half of its cached top examples are at position 0, and a window_start_artefact if at least half are within the first 4 positions; its maximum then describes the window start, and examples_in_context gives its top examples from later positions. At position 0 the residual depends only on the character itself.
